dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, my phone is in my bag. I'm very worried.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, maɪ ˈfoʊn ɪz ɪn maɪ ˈbæɡ. aɪm ˈvɛri ˈwɜːrid.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry, Emma. The police can help.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri, ˈɛmə. ðə pəˈliːs kən ˈhɛlp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Please write your name and phone number here.
dialogue.reading: ˈpliːz ˈraɪt jʊr ˈneɪm ənd ˈfoʊn ˌnʌmbər ˈhɪr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: English is OK. Take your time.
dialogue.reading: ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz oʊˈkeɪ. ˈteɪk jʊr ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thank you for your help. You're very kind.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ˈhɛlp. jʊr ˈvɛri ˈkaɪnd.
